record.field: Python: models, computed fields, constraints, views
Follow the membership fees of the shared gardens, and only rent the plots to the members who paid this year.

field.name: description
field.p: Gaart fir Jiddereen (“a garden for everyone”) runs shared gardens in Bonnevoie (Luxembourg) and in the Brill district (Esch-sur-Alzette): 20 members, 12 plots to rent.

The treasurer follows the membership fees in a spreadsheet, and some plots are rented by members who did not pay this year. Complete the module trivia_garden so that Odoo does the job. The TODOs of the code are numbered like the tasks below.

ol.li: The fees (models/garden_membership_fee.py): the model garden.membership.fee and its fields, at most one fee per member and per year, and the method action_mark_paid().
Access rights (security/ir.access.csv): the internal users can read, create, modify and delete the fees.

Views of the fees (views/garden_membership_fee_views.xml, views/menus.xml): a list view, a form view with the status in its header and a Mark as paid button only visible on draft fees, an action and a menu.
The members (models/res_partner.py): the fields of the members on the contacts, among which last_paid_year, stored and always up to date.
The contact form (views/res_partner_views.xml): a Membership page, and a Not up to date filter for the members who did not pay the current year.
The plots (models/garden_plot.py): only a member who paid the fee of the current year can rent a plot, and a member rents one plot at most.
The data (__manifest__.py): load the fees of the members, data/garden_membership_fee_data.xml.

field.p: ⭐ Bonus: a Fees smart button on the contact form, and a kanban view of the plots grouped by site.

💡 After changing Python code, or adding a file, a field or a record, update the modules (make update), then click on Check. In Odoo 20, the access rights are declared in security/ir.access.csv: look at the lines already there.
